assertions: the public container image shape must not depend on private infra IR
the final image must run the control-plane binary as a non-root user
the exposed port and runtime env must match the public runtime contract
the build stage must use BuildKit cache mounts for Go module and build caches without adding runtime dependencies

loop.observation: Runtime image shape can drift from the public source contract when Dockerfile details are reviewed as prose or by memory.
loop.hypothesis: A container image contract can keep the Dockerfile, binary entrypoint, exposed port, non-root user, and optional Fargate IR checks executable.
loop.execute: Parse the Dockerfile, compare build and final stage fields against this contract, and emit strict CI evidence.
loop.evaluate: CI uploads container-image-contract evidence with status, check count, image shape, and this loop metadata.
loop.retrospective: The public repository owns the buildable runtime artifact contract while private infra remains responsible for deployment shape.
